7._section_summary: This section presents factor analysis and reliability results for the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in male participants. The BAS demonstrated adequate sampling adequacy (KMO = .88) and a one-factor solution explaining 38.3% of variance, with good internal consistency (α = .85).
